name: rename-koala-env-vars-to-lattice
title: Rename the KOALA_* runtime env-var contract to LATTICE_* (open-source ship-clean)
description: For the open-source launch, eliminate the KOALA_* environment-variable layer with NO koala fallback. The ~57 KOALA_* vars (~595 uses) split into 17 that already have a LATTICE_* dual-read twin (drop the `|| KOALA_X` fallback) and 38 KOALA-only vars (rename to LATTICE_X) across reads, setters, JSON configs, .Codex/.claude wrapper assets, hook-contract docs, and tests. This is an intentional breaking change (external shells/CI/Codex wrappers exporting KOALA_* must switch to LATTICE_*), acceptable pre-launch with no external users. First substantive story of the ship-clean koala-removal program. Also drops the docs/koala/legacy/ archive. Out of scope: .koala/ runtime dir + LEGACY_KOALA_* path constants, docs/koala/framework-audit (active), koala.config.json/marker parsing, experiments/ data, CHANGELOG/history rewrite.
